description: Public research dossier: 3I/ATLAS seeding hypothesis frame cross-referenced with IT3 Framework claims from a public Harvard–Smithsonian MPC catalog audit (@dr_logvinovich). 3I is scored as free macro-electron with E_ion +9.43 (highest among known ISOs) under IT3 — interesting alignment with a seeding/carrier narrative, not proof of intent. Author claims only; not peer-reviewed or engine-confirmed.

seeding_hypothesis.posture: Hypothesis alignment only. IT3 claims are author assertions; MPC is a public catalog. Neither proves intentional seeding.
